body.markdown_zh:
还有２天！！ 倒计时已经开始了！！ [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/) 现在距离发售日还有　３１：２５：５７ 不知怎么的，有点紧张……（笑） 昨晚还梦见谁都不肯买……（汗） 不不。 调整好心情！ 任天堂网站上的《社长问问》已经公开了ＢＷ版。 我回答岩田社长的问题时，聊得还挺深入的！ [http://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/irbj/index.html](http://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/irbj/index.html) ９月１８日（星期六）宝可梦黑·白发售！！ 台场的麦当劳变成“宝可梦ＢＷ麦当劳”了！ 这当然得一大早去看看了！ [http://www.mcd-holdings.co.jp/news/2010/promotion/promo0914b.html](http://www.mcd-holdings.co.jp/news/2010/promotion/promo0914b.html) 宝可梦中心东京好像也已经备齐新的小物件了！ 我要去领取预订好的ＢＷ了！ [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/info/2010/08/p100813_01.html](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/info/2010/08/p100813_01.html) ９月２３日（星期四）六本木新城举办活动！！ 宝可梦祭典！Best Wishes [http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_bw/](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_bw/) 要不要点进去看看？？ [http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/) 宝可梦搜索者ＢＷ也会来！ 还没乘坐过的人一定要去试试！ 特别影片正在公开！ [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/event/about/searcher/index.html?a001=main](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/event/about/searcher/index.html?a001=main) 气氛越来越热烈了！！ 宝可梦黑·白的相关情报和活动也 请大家尽情期待吧！！ 下回再见啦！
查看官方英文版 Two more days!! Clock is ticking!! [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/) 31hrs 25min 57sec to go. I become tense… Last night, I had a dream which nobody is buying… No no, Cheer up! Story of Pokemon Black/White is disclosed on Nintendo’s website called “Shacho ga kiku.” [http://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/irbj/index.html](http://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/irbj/index.html) I talked deeply to Mr. Iwata’s question. *”Shacho ga kiku” is interview from Nintendo’s president, Mr. Iwata. On Saturday Septemver 18th, Pokemon Black/White have launched!! Odaiba’s McDonald changes into “Pokemon Black/White MacDonald”! I’m going to see this change first thing in the morning. [http://www.mcd-holdings.co.jp/news/2010/promotion/promo0914b.html](http://www.mcd-holdings.co.jp/news/2010/promotion/promo0914b.html) *Odaiba is one of the major city in Tokyo. In Pokemon Center Tokyo, new goods are available! I’ll go to Pokemon Center Tokyo for reserved my Black/White. [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/info/2010/08/p100813_01.html](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/info/2010/08/p100813_01.html) On Thursday September 23rd, event will be held at Roppongi Hills. It’s Pokemon festival! Best Wishes [http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_bw/](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_bw/) Click here?? [http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/) Pokemon searcher Black/White is coming! Whoever not experienced before, plase give it a try! Special movie playing! [http://www.pokemon.co.jp/event/about/searcher/index.html?a001=main](http://www.pokemon.co.jp/event/about/searcher/index.html?a001=main) It’s getting exciting!! Please enjoy Pokemon Black/White not only the information but event, too!! Ciao!
